trigger.description: An explicit include-tombstoned request cannot execute its supplemental source-archive lexical retrieval because the complete retired corpus exceeds 4096 documents or 16 MiB of body/projected content, or the lexical backend/source snapshot is unavailable. The supplement returns no partial corpus, and admitted live index matches remain available with this explicit warning. In the separately stored user-global lane, the supplement runs only after healthy index and source admission; missing, stale or corrupt historical global indexes retain global_index_unavailable instead.
setup_commands: # In an isolated store with a healthy live index, create more than 4096 admitted matching tombstones, or a retired corpus exceeding the 16-MiB source retrieval bound.
# Keep a matching live record indexed to verify the failed historical supplement does not discard already admitted live results.

message_contains: Supplemental historical lexical retrieval was unavailable
